description: This file defines the interface for managing temperature sensors, including functions to get current temperature, set thresholds, and retrieve thresholds. It also defines related types and constants.

methods.name: mfrGetTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves the current temperature and temperature state of the core.

methods.name: mfrSetTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets temperature thresholds for high and critical temperature warnings.

methods.name: mfrGetTempThresholds
methods.description: Gets the current temperature thresholds for high and critical states.

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_CRITICAL
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_CRITICAL       \/* Temp is critical, should trigger a thermal reset *\/$/

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_HIGH
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_HIGH,          \/* Temp is high, but just a warning as device can still opera/

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_NORMAL
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_NORMAL = 0,    \/* Temp is within normal operating range *\/$/
